body:
Hey there! Writing copy, blogs, and content is eating up your week—let's fix that with AI tools that actually work. Here are this week's best picks to get your writing done faster.

## This Week's Top Picks

**Notion AI**
Write, summarize, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for small teams already using Notion who want AI help built right in. Free + $10/mo.
[Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy, social posts, and ad text in seconds. Best for founders who need quick variations without hiring a copywriter. Free + $36/mo.
[Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Surfer SEO**
Write content that's optimized for Google rankings from the start. Best for bloggers and content marketers who want traffic, not just words. $89/mo.
[Try Surfer SEO →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

---

## Quick Tip

AI writing tools work best when you give them context. Instead of "write a product description," try "write a 50-word product description for eco-conscious moms buying reusable water bottles—highlight durability and sustainability." Better input = better output. Takes 30 seconds more to write the prompt, saves 30 minutes on editing.
